title: Sealed With Feeling
summary: Advocate Reyes is executing an inconvenient debt and has found the elegant instrument: the debtor's own pennant is flying locked at Keel Town while the season flag rotates — and pennant code says a debt sleeps with the ship unless the pennant reaches the mast before rotation. Ride the pennant line, read the code at every gate, and decide how the writ gets signed.

objectives.label: Take the writ from the dockmaster's hut, mesa top
Run the pennant line before the season flag rotates
Return the pennant — one way or another

offer.text: Courier Varga. A colleague's file — let us keep the name in a drawer — owes the Guild a season of moorage and dislikes theme of payment. I am executing the debt, and the law, being occasionally beautiful, has handed me the debtor's own pennant code as the instrument.

The pennant flies *locked* at their mast. Under pennant code, while it flies, the debt sleeps with the ship — but the season flag rotates at dusk-mark, and a read pennant outruns a locked one. Carry the writ round the pennant line. Each checkpoint reads the code aloud. The skyship will convict itself in colours.
Yours will be the legs, Varga, and — in one small clause — the heart. I never draft the heart. Section nine forbids me, and I have learned to be glad of it.

accept.text: Code reading, from the spotter's supplement: amber over bone — the debt acknowledged. Bone over rust — the debt disputed. A grief pennant you do not read at all; you slow down for it. The checkpoints will teach you the rest. Rotation in one-fifty, nota bene, and the law does not grant extensions for scenery.
Devanna at the hut. Writ's inked and waxed, courier. Read the pennants pretty for me — dock rule says a code read wrong is a year of gulls, and I have *had* my year of gulls.
Copy. Writ aboard, one-fifty on the clock, delivering a ship's own flag back to it as an invoice. The Driftline keeps finding new shapes for a letter.
A dunning letter is a railing on a stair, courier. You are about to climb the debtor's own mast by it. Test the joinery.

complete.text: The pennant reached the mast with the season flag still un-rotated. Debt executed, ship ruled *sundry, payable* — the words the code saves for people who taught their own colours to testify. Yours, in lien.

And the *delivery*, Varga. I watched the line from the mesa. You read a grief pennant correctly at thirty knots, which is to say you were briefly the most law-abiding thing in Kessa-9 airspace. I have filed it under 'visits of concern', subsection: pride.

Rotation came and went, pennant legal, gulls unpaid. Whoever the name in the drawer is, they owe you the interesting kind of favour — the kind that's a debt and doesn't know it. The Driftline ledger remembers, courier. Even when the ink's somebody else's.

choices.prompt: The executed pennant is heavy in your hand. Paragraph three says the executor's courier decides: formal service, or quiet mercy?

options.text: Hand the pennant to Reyes, waxed and witnessed — the letter of the law.
Tuck it under the debtor's door with a note: 'Your flag reads honest. Keep it flying.'
